title: Beyond Immerse™ Now Available at Erewhon
body_markdown:
*Beyond Meat’s first functional beverage line makes its way to recognized wellness destination*


El Segundo, Calif. (August 24, 2026) -- Beyond Meat, Inc. (NASDAQ: BYND), otherwise known as Beyond The Plant Protein Company™, today announced that Beyond Immerse is now available at Erewhon locations across Southern California. The launch marks the next chapter in the rollout of the brand's first functional beverage line, following its introduction to consumers in the New York metropolitan area through[Big Geyser](https://www.beyondmeat.com/en-US/press/beyond-meat-launches-beyond-immerse-in-new-york) and its availability nationwide through the company’s direct-to-consumer[website](https://beyondtestkitchen.com/collections/drinks) .


"Bringing Beyond Immerse to Erewhon represents an exciting next step for our first functional beverage line," said Ethan Brown, Founder and CEO of Beyond Meat. "We created Beyond Immerse to deliver the superpowers of plants in one light and refreshing drink, and we look forward to bringing it to Erewhon, a retailer that has long been at the forefront of what's next in wellness and reaches a community deeply engaged in how nutrition can support everyday life."


Beyond Immerse brings a new kind of functional beverage to Erewhon, reflecting a shared commitment to thoughtfully crafted nutrition and products made with simple ingredients. Beyond Immerse combines four distinct beverage offerings—plant protein, fiber, antioxidants, and electrolytes—in one lightly sparkling can. Available in Peach Mango, Strawberry Lemonade, and Cherry Berry, each can delivers 20g of plant protein, 5g of fiber, antioxidants, and electrolytes for just 110 calories, with no dairy or whey protein.


**About Beyond Meat**


Beyond Meat, Inc. (NASDAQ: BYND), otherwise known as Beyond The Plant Protein Company™, is a plant protein company offering a portfolio of plant-based products made with non-GMO ingredients, no added hormones or antibiotics, and 0mg of cholesterol per serving. Founded in 2009, Beyond Meat’s core products are designed to have the same taste and texture as animal-based meat while being better for people and the planet. The company’s brand promise, Eat What You Love®, represents a strong belief that there is a better way to feed our future and that the positive choices we all make, no matter how small, can have a great impact on our personal health and the health of our planet. By shifting from animal-based protein to plant-based protein, we can positively impact four growing global issues: human health, climate change, constraints on natural resources and animal welfare. Visit[www.BeyondMeat.com](https://www.beyondmeat.com/) and follow @BeyondMeat on Facebook, Instagram, Threads and LinkedIn.

**About Erewhon**


Erewhon is an independent, family-owned Certified B Corporation and Certified Organic Retailer with 14 locations across Southern California. Since 1968, Erewhon has been providing organic, ethically-sourced foods to the communities it serves. It’s committed to sourcing high-quality, nutrient-dense products, backing local growers and brands, and supporting the environment. Recognized for uncompromising quality standards, exceptional customer service, and chef-driven prepared foods, Erewhon sustains a community centered in caring, curiosity, and positive change.


For more information, visit erewhon.com
